FerrinX.note: FerrinX is a 50:50 joint venture established by De Novo Foodlabs and Earth First Food Ventures.

Lactoprot Deutschland GmbH.note: The majority of shares in Lactoprot Deutschland GmbH were sold by ARTAX AG and acquired by its long-term managing director Steffen Rode via a management buyout in 2012.

Ark Bio Solutions.note: Ark Bio Solutions is an independent private biotechnology startup founded in Brazil in 2022.

BluNutrients.note: BluNutrients is an independent India-based startup developing solvent-free membrane extraction technologies.

Glanbia Ingredients Ireland.note: Glanbia Co-operative Society acquired full ownership of the joint venture in 2022 and rebranded the business as Tirlán.

Nanjing Bestzyme Bio-Engineering Co., Lt.note: GenScript Biotech Corporation acquired a 51% majority stake in the target company in 2016.

ProviCo Pty Ltd.note: ProviCo Pty Ltd remains an independent family-owned Australian animal nutrition and bio-protein manufacturer.

Vivici.note: Vivici is an independent Dutch precision fermentation startup founded in 2023 as a joint venture backed by Fonterra and DSM-Firmenich.
